answer: Each new agent must lock a bond and earn vouches from a few randomly picked, already-staked peers, with no peer allowed to vouch twice in an epoch. The overlapping endorsements make a trellis of independent trust, and the sole bridge from an unknown agent into the network is a quorum drawn from separate wallets. For k fake identities an attacker pays k bonds plus bribes to k disjoint quorums, so cost rises faster than k as honest peers refuse repeats, and the vine of attestations collapses when any caught vouch is slashed.
